nodes.label: desktop memory - check what exists before adding

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. Before writing any new file, module or structure, first check whether it already exists - query the active graphify graph with graphify query, graphify explain and graphify path, and look at the directory tree - then reuse or extend what is there rather than creating a parallel copy. The trigger: while scaffolding the eval harness an agent created a directory duplicating an already-existing export contract and gold loader, an existing real gold-100 set (making an empty chosen_questions.jsonl beside it), and existing runners in the baselines, all of which one graph query surfaced instantly. The user: 'you always just fucking keep adding shit without EVER looking to see if there already exist.. even with the fucking graph you still wont just take a peek.' CANON_AUDIT.md lists this among the grounded, verbatim-quoted and correct desktop entries
